title: Ambient sequence pullback data with published category types
statement: PublishedSystemAmbientData records, in coefficientSequenceDerived, a pullback functor for each scheme morphism, its tensor comparison, and a compositor. publishedSystemAmbientData is the actual sequence-site ambient derivedPull, tensorData.mu, and derivedComp with systemClosed and systemTensorModel from pullbackTensorCalculus. It makes no new choices. Its pull field equals pullbackTensorSequenceDerived by sequence_derived_eq. The specified identification isomorphism publishedSystemAmbientPullIso is eqToIso of that proved equality. [lem-sf-system-pullback-compositor-identification] [lem-sf-ambient-pullback-tensor-coherence]

proof.text: Record derivedPull, the tensorData comparison with the published systemClosed structures and systemTensorModel models, and derivedComp. Their sequence-site categories are definitionally the coefficientSequenceDerived categories. Apply sequence_derived_eq to prove the pull-field identification.
